description:
The dataset was created by collecting videos from various sources and combining them into a single directory with validation and training data for four main classes: Fight, NonFight, HockeyFight, and MovieFight mainly for multiclass violence detection.

Sources: 
For Fight and Non-Fight Classes, we combined videos from RWF-2000 and the Real Life Violence Situations Dataset.
For the HockeyFight class, we used the Hockey Fight dataset, For the MovieFight class, various videos from YouTube were collected and clipped according to requirements.

AIRTLab.exact_license_text_or_agreement: No root LICENSE file in repository. README states: 'Please cite the following paper if you use this dataset in your research: Bianculli et al., A dataset for automatic violence detection in videos, Data in Brief 2020.' Retrieval Date: 2026-10-26.
AIRTLab.applies_to: Research paper citation only. Repository lacks any standard permissive license (CC BY 4.0, MIT, Apache) covering the video media files.
AIRTLab.restrictions_and_consent: Research and educational citation requirement only. No commercial license granted. Subjects recorded under academic experimental protocol.
